svg.text: Ticketing API: AWS Container Architecture (Track B)
Amazon EC2 + Docker + Amazon ECR · 2 services: ticket-api (built image) + ticket-db (MySQL 8.0) · Diffie Alfierie Iswanto (533049) · Cloud Computing, Week 12
AWS Cloud: AWS Academy Learner Lab account
Security group ticket-api-sg inbound: tcp/80 from 0.0.0.0/0 · tcp/22 from EC2 Instance Connect range only
t3.micro · Amazon Linux 2023 · Docker Engine + Compose · IMDSv2
temporary creds, no keys on disk
Scripts are idempotent. infra/teardown.sh terminates EC2 and deletes the SG + ECR repo after grading.
Cost: t3.micro ≈ $0.01/hour (Learner Lab stops it when the session ends) + about 60 MB of ECR storage.
Client sends HTTP to the EC2 public IP :80 (IGW, SG allows tcp/80) → ticket-api :8000
ticket-api validates input and runs parameterized SQL on ticket-db over the private network
MySQL returns the rows / write result
ticket-api returns JSON (201/200/204/400/404) to the client
• Network: only :80 is public; SSH only from EC2 Instance Connect; MySQL is never exposed
• IAM: instance profile (LabRole) for ECR, so no access keys; IMDSv2 enforced
• Containers: non-root API user, ECR scan on push, random DB passwords in a git-ignored .env
• Planned: ALB + HTTPS (ACM), instance in a private subnet, move DB to Amazon RDS
